TRIXX Farm

Irrigate on soil moisture, not on guesswork.

TRIXX Farm turns a plot into a managed system. Sensors report moisture at three depths, the controller waters only when the soil asks, and every litre and hour is logged so you can see what the season actually cost.

18 MB Android · 44 MB iOS Android 8.0+iOS 14+Web dashboard
▶ Get it onGoogle Play Download on theApp Store

Features

What TRIXX Farm does

  • ✓Soil-moisture and temperature sensing at 3 depths
  • ✓Zone irrigation schedules with weather-aware skipping
  • ✓Water and pump-hour accounting per zone
  • ✓Livestock water level and trough monitoring
  • ✓Planting calendar with yield logging
  • ✓Offline schedule that runs without network

TRIXX Farm by the numbers

  • Water savedup to 41%
  • Labour savedup to 12 hrs/wk
  • Zones per controller16

Included with your TRIXX account

One login covers the website and all five apps. No separate subscription for core features.
